title: Information Content of Book and Trade Order Flow at Different Trading Volume Time Scales
about: Price-direction prediction from NASDAQ stock order books at volume-time scales.
findings: Authors report informational advantage dissipating within10milliseconds. No independent performance verification.
mechanism: Trade flow can briefly reveal information, but latency and competition determine monetization.
build_on: 35stock LOB histories and millisecond event clocks are absent. NQ minute fields are neither those stocks nor a10ms feed; no new trade hypothesis.
code_feasibility: A research classifier is possible with source/event data. Our current minute data cannot reproduce that horizon.
